requirements.message: Source changes must pass the approved syntax hygiene checks.

explain.summary: Explain suppressions and keep deterministic unit tests independent of real time.
mustDo: Use a fixed epoch or controlled clock in unit tests.
Await observable completion rather than timer delays.
mustNotDo: Do not silence findings by weakening the policy or broadening excludes.
explain.exampleGood: // oxlint-disable-next-line repo-hygiene/deterministic-unit-tests -- Measures actual process timeout; covered by integration suite.
